overview: This Senate resolution names September 20 through 27, 2026, as "Gold Star Families Remembrance Week." A gold star is the symbol for a family that has lost a loved one who died while serving in the U.S. armed forces. The resolution notes that the last Sunday in September is already Gold Star Mother's Day under federal law, but that there is no date set aside for whole families. It honors the sacrifices of families of fallen service members and of veterans, and encourages Americans to mark the week with acts of service in their communities. It does not change any law or benefits. The Senate approved it by unanimous consent on September 24, 2026.
for: Supporters say the families of service members who died serving the country deserve broad recognition beyond the existing Gold Star Mother's Day.
against: Critics say the resolution is symbolic and does not change any law, benefits or spending for these families.
